testcase.name: a requested region delete is pending, hidden from visibleOfflineRegions, and the tile delete is not called
a failed download is reported as Failed, not silently as success, without the repository's raw message
deleting a region removes it from offlineRegions
a successful download ends Succeeded, targeting the picked region under a default name
an out-of-range latitude is rejected the same way
an in-flight download reports Downloading with the latest progress reported so far
Download again downloads from the row's stored centre and radius through the existing download, then replaces the old row
a listRegions read failure is reported via offlineRegionsErrorMessage, not silently as an empty list
committing a pending region delete runs the tile delete once, for that region
a failed Download again keeps the row and reports the failure as a download failure
reflects what listRegions reports as already downloaded, on startup
the slider's maximum radius fits the budget at the archive's northern edge and reaches the repository
a last-picked radius from before the ceiling shrank is restored at the ceiling
undo of a pending region delete shows it again and deletes no tiles
the offline map region is independent of the main search region
a region delete still pending when the ViewModel is cleared is committed
invalid coordinates are rejected without ever calling the repository
reloading after a restore reads the region lists again
Download again is held to the same tile budget as any download
a restored region with no tiles is listed beside the downloaded ones, marked as not downloaded
starts Idle with no regions when nothing is on disk
a second region delete commits the first when it replaces it
the offline map radius is clamped to the offline ceiling, not the search radius's
a delete failure is reported via offlineRegionsErrorMessage rather than silently leaving the region
